_comment: Editable account context for Braid. Every field carries a status: 'confirmed' (source-backed), 'unknown' (not yet supplied), 'prior' (operator/methodology experience, not a Braid fact), 'computed' (from output/step1). Do not fill unknowns with guesses. Bubble experience is a methodology source only.

target_customer.why_it_matters: decides whether developer (github), enterprise and internal-tool intents are on-target

product_category.value: ai app builder (from the scope label)
product_category.source: candidate brief scope label 'Non-Brand ai app builder'

subscription_model.why_it_matters: what a 'Sub' is (monthly/annual, self-serve vs sales-assisted) and whether one sub is comparable across terms

free_to_paid_path.why_it_matters: whether a free tier exists; if so, 'free' searches may be on-path and signup->sub lag applies

enterprise_offering.why_it_matters: if enterprise deals close via sales, self-serve Subs undercount the value of enterprise-intent terms

developer_integrations.why_it_matters: whether 'github' intent (export code / import repo) is served by the product

no_code_positioning.why_it_matters: whether 'without code' and 'vibe coding' audiences match the product's positioning

customer_value.why_it_matters: LTV/margin needed to judge whether $181 per sub is right for any given intent

conversion_cycle.why_it_matters: signup->paid lag; without it, Subs in the same window as Regs may be immature for some terms

strategic_posture.note: The diagnosis shows conditional handling under both options and does not choose.

allowable.source: candidate brief (Task 1); applies to Non-Brand search terms
allowable.per_term_applicability: used as the operator-supplied ceiling for each term; not raised or adjusted here

performance_benchmark.note: descriptive benchmark of the scope the terms belong to; not a business target

methodology_priors.source: Bubble keyword-diagnose methodology (reference/keyword-diagnose); priors, not Braid facts
methodology_priors.bidding_signal_vs_kpi: bid on an early, high-volume signal; judge on paid subs; verify the lag before reuse
methodology_priors.review_order: by spend, then check data sufficiency and attribution before acting

data_sufficiency_thresholds.status: unset; operator to supply; not invented
